newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields: 3-,9-,12-mo up, 6-mo down.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields: 3-,9-,12-mo up, 6-mo down.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-, nine-, and 12-month treasury bills edged up and yields of six-month treasury bills slipped from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Monday.

Three-month bills edged up to 24.33 percent from 24.24 percent, six-month bills slipped to 30.52 percent from 30.68 percent, nine-month bills rose to 34.88 percent from 34.45 percent, and 12-month bills firmed to 39.64 percent from 39.56 percent.
The results of Friday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 3.24 million UAH 1.56 million UAH
Actual amount raised 3.05 million UAH 1.47 million UAH
The central bank sold 32,408 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 32,162 were competitive and 246 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 7.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated 35.00 million UAH
Amount sold 11.08 million UAH 3.75 million UAH
Actual amount raised 9.61 million UAH 3.25 million UAH
The central bank sold 110,777 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 110,317 were competitive and 460 were non-competitive.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 7.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated 45.00 million UAH
Amount sold 21.44 million UAH 1.87 million UAH
Actual amount raised 17.00 million UAH 1.49 million UAH
The central bank sold 214,369 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 214,349 were competitive and 20 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 7.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated 55.00 million UAH
Amount sold 29.41 million UAH 3.61 million UAH
Actual amount raised 21.08 million UAH 2.59 million UAH
The central bank sold 294,150 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 294,047 were competitive and 103 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 7.
